reason: Classic chains are deprecated. LangChain now composes runnables (LCEL) or agents.
fix: Replace LLMChain(llm=llm, prompt=prompt) with chain = prompt | llm | StrOutputParser(), then chain.invoke({...}).
snippet:
from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate
from langchain_core.output_parsers import StrOutputParser
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI

prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_template("Answer: {q}")
chain = prompt | ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4.1-mini") | StrOutputParser()
print(chain.invoke({"q": "hi"}))

reason: initialize_agent is removed from modern LangChain. Use the new agent API or LangGraph.
fix: Use create_agent(model, tools) or create_react_agent(model, tools) and invoke with {"messages":[...]} .
snippet:
from langchain.agents import create_agent
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI

agent = create_agent(ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4.1-mini"), tools=[...])
agent.invoke({"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "search X"}]})

reason: Partner integrations moved to dedicated packages (langchain-openai, langchain-anthropic, ...).
fix: pip install langchain-openai and import ChatOpenAI from langchain_openai, or use init_chat_model("openai:gpt-4.1-mini").
snippet:
from langchain.chat_models import init_chat_model
model = init_chat_model("openai:gpt-4.1-mini")

replacement: create_retrieval_chain + create_stuff_documents_chain  or a custom LCEL rag graph
reason: RetrievalQA wrappers hide LCEL and break streaming/tool-calling.
fix: retriever = vectorstore.as_retriever(); build prompt | model; use create_retrieval_chain(retriever, combine_docs_chain).
snippet:
from langchain.chains.combine_documents import create_stuff_documents_chain
from langchain.chains import create_retrieval_chain
combine = create_stuff_documents_chain(model, prompt)
rag = create_retrieval_chain(retriever, combine)
rag.invoke({"input": "What is LCEL?"})

reason: GPT* index names were renamed. Use VectorStoreIndex (and other Index classes) from llama_index.core.
fix: from llama_index.core import VectorStoreIndex, SimpleDirectoryReader; index = VectorStoreIndex.from_documents(docs)
snippet:
from llama_index.core import VectorStoreIndex, SimpleDirectoryReader
docs = SimpleDirectoryReader("./data").load_data()
index = VectorStoreIndex.from_documents(docs)
print(index.as_query_engine().query("Summarize"))

reason: ServiceContext is removed. Global/runtime configuration lives on Settings.
fix: Set Settings.llm and Settings.embed_model once; do not pass service_context= into indexes.
snippet:
from llama_index.core import Settings
from llama_index.llms.openai import OpenAI
from llama_index.embeddings.openai import OpenAIEmbedding
Settings.llm = OpenAI(model="gpt-4.1-mini")
Settings.embed_model = OpenAIEmbedding(model="text-embedding-3-small")

replacement: from llama_index.core import ...  plus integration packages
reason: The monolith package split: core + llama-index-llms-* + llama-index-embeddings-* + readers.
fix: pip install llama-index llama-index-llms-openai llama-index-embeddings-openai. Import Document, VectorStoreIndex from llama_index.core.
snippet:
from llama_index.core import Document, VectorStoreIndex
from llama_index.llms.openai import OpenAI

deprecated: POST /api/generate with a chat-style messages array
reason: Multi-turn chat belongs on /api/chat. /api/generate is a single prompt completion API.
fix: Use POST /api/chat with { model, messages: [{role, content}] } or client.chat(model=..., messages=...).
snippet:
import ollama
r = ollama.chat(model="llama3.2", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}])
print(r["message"]["content"])

deprecated: llama2 / llama2:latest as a default model tag
replacement: llama3.2 (or another pulled model from `ollama list`)
patterns: pull model manifest: file does not exist
reason: llama2 is no longer the recommended default and may not be pulled.
fix: ollama pull llama3.2  then pass model="llama3.2". List local tags with `ollama list`.
snippet:
ollama pull llama3.2
ollama run llama3.2

deprecated: OpenAI client pointed at http://localhost:11434/v1 without a pulled model
replacement: base_url http://localhost:11434/v1  AND a local model name (not gpt-4)
reason: Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint serves local tags, not OpenAI model names.
fix: Set openai.base_url to http://localhost:11434/v1 and model to a pulled tag such as llama3.2.
snippet:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:11434/v1", api_key="ollama")
client.chat.completions.create(model="llama3.2", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}])
